summary.activity_gate_note: Experimental 20 ms boundary and 100 ms parent energy gate; may miss soft snoring. Not a breathing classifier.
summary.interpretation: Audio snore estimate only; not medical severity.
summary.level_note: Relative digital dBFS; not calibrated dB SPL.

inference.runtime: TFLite WASM + exported trained Dense heads
inference.activity_gate: max(-60, P20 + min(6,(P95-P20)/2)) dBFS over finite 100 ms parents >= -80; 20 ms cells must also pass

combined.interpretation: Project-defined experimental composite. Requires both categories; no renormalization when missing. Not validated sleep quality or health risk.

duration_points.interpretation: Project-defined transformation of snoring duration. Higher means less detected snoring time; not health or sleep quality.

pattern_points.interpretation: Project-defined experimental score using the STII interval criterion, not the published STII formula. Higher means fewer qualifying intervals; not health or regularity. No intervals means unavailable.

snore_burden.interpretation: Higher means more recorded time classified as snoring; not health risk.

stii_recording.interpretation: Experimental adaptation using detected segment starts and recording hours, not sleep hours; not AHI or validated OSA risk.

pss.interpretation: Unavailable: requires calibrated psychoacoustic loudness N5 and mean roughness. RMS/dBFS cannot substitute.
